definitions.meaning: The bottom, ground, floor, the earth

quotations.english: he could perceive the bottom [of the lake]
to give up the earth, to die

source_text: grund-wang, -wong, es; m. The bottom, ground, floor, the earth :-- He ðone grundwong ongytan mihte he could perceive the bottom [of the lake], Beo. Th. 2996; B. 1496: 5533; B. 2770. Grundwong ofgyfan to give up the earth, to die, 5169; B. 2588.
